title: Reserve spillover contract and commit liveness prover
author: Priya Mahadevan
description: Introduce a soft "reserve spillover" contract to allow tenants on Dedicated fleets to temporarily borrow unused capacity across commitment boundaries while preserving minimum throughput guarantees; add a commit liveness prover that verifies reservation health and enables autoscaler to prefer stable reservations over transient ones. Motivation: observed churn when tight reservation aging collides with short-lived bursts leading to repeated scale-ups/downs and SLA slippage for high-commitment tenants. Design highlights: 1) Spillover contract is a probabilistic loan: a tenant can be granted spillover credits from a global soft-pool if utilization and headroom thresholds are satisfied; credits decay and are revocable when the pledged tenant needs the capacity back. 2) Commit liveness prover periodically proves that a reservation holder is actively serving their committed workload (latency and token throughput sampling); proven-live reservations get a weighted stability bonus in scaling decisions. 3) Autoscaler policy changes: incorporate spillover credits and liveness score into the scale decision function with hysteresis to avoid thrash; prefer reclaiming spillover before scaling cluster-wide; reduce eagerness to preempt reservations with high liveness. 4) Telemetry and reporting: new metrics tenant:spillover_allocated, tenant:spillover_reclaimed, tenant:liveness_score, global:softpool_fill_percentile, and an event log for spillover grants/revocations; add a per-tenant percentile utilization reporter for 50/90/99 token throughput and latency. 5) Config surface: spillover.max_fraction, spillover.decay_seconds, liveness.sample_window_seconds, autoscaler.liveness_weight, autoscaler.reclaim_threshold. Migration and safety: default deployment is off; enabling requires opt-in tenant flag or cluster toggle; rollout plan uses feature flag and staged rollout across Dedicated fleets. Backwards compatibility: system falls back to existing reservation semantics when disabled. Rollback plan: remove feature flag and drain soft-pool grants; instrumentation added to make rollback observable. Testing and validation: unit tests for contract accounting and prover; integration harness simulating interleaved bursts; stressing on perf-canary to verify SLOs under mixed workloads. Related: addresses customer incident SUP-983 where a high-commitment tenant experienced repeated capacity thrash; also references ENG-4567 autoscaler stability epic. This PR includes docs, config examples, and a migration checklist.

review_comments: Luke Carter: Overall pattern looks good but need clearer invariants around reclaim order and tenant fairness; can you add a short proof sketch or invariant checks?
Priya Mahadevan: Added invariant comments in spillover_pool.go and a simple assertion in accounting to ensure global softpool never exceeds configured fraction.
Mei Chen: The liveness prover's sampling window may penalize bursty but healthy workloads; can we expose window config and add an exponential backoff for initial sampling?
Priya Mahadevan: Exposed liveness.sample_window_seconds and added a bootstrap backoff for newly created reservations to avoid false negatives.

Diego Alvarez: CI failed on the autoscaler integration test initially; looks like a race when reclaiming spillover while scaling down. Please ensure locks are fine-grained and add a test that reproduces the race.
Priya Mahadevan: Fixed locking and added autoscaler/decision_test.go case that reproduces the previous race; CI passes locally.
merge_summary: Squash-merged after approvals from Luke, Mei and Diego. No merge conflicts. Performance canary scheduled post-merge for cross-fleet validation.
release_notes: Added opt-in spillover contracts for Dedicated fleets to temporarily borrow unused capacity with decay and revocation; introduced commit liveness prover to stabilize autoscaler decisions; new telemetry: tenant:spillover_allocated, tenant:spillover_reclaimed, tenant:liveness_score; config knobs under spillover.* and autoscaler.liveness_weight; off by default.
notes_for_ops: Enable via cluster feature-flag 'enable_spillover' and optional per-tenant flag 'dedicated.spillover.enabled'. Monitor global:softpool_fill_percentile and tenant:liveness_score; set conservative spillover.max_fraction <= 0.10 during early rollout.
qa_checklist: Integration test for reclaim during scale events
Perf-canary to validate SLOs under mixed usage
Manual staged rollout: enable on a single fleet, monitor metrics for 24h
incident_link: SUP-983: capacity thrash affecting tenant X
notes: This PR aims to reduce throttling-induced thrash by biasing autoscaler toward proven-live reservations and by using a soft spillover pool to absorb transient bursts; it is intentionally conservative and opt-in to avoid unexpected billing semantics.
